\noindent\textbf{Camouflage net.}\label{des:camouflage_net} Camouflage net on poles: thin cubes sagging between the supports, with gaps. 7 instances; the first stands 9\,m north of the bunker, inside the command bunker. Placement of the first: $T(0.00,\allowbreak\,0.16,\allowbreak\,9.00)\allowbreak\,R_y(0^\circ)\allowbreak\,S(1)$.

Generation rule: a $w\times d$ net is cut into a grid of about 1.15\,m panels (thin boxes) that sag as $h(u,v)=h_0-s\sin\pi u\sin\pi v$ and tilt with the slope; 12\,\% of the panels are left out at random; poles at the corners (and mid-edge for sides over 5.5\,m), four edge ropes. The 7 instances differ in size: 37, 55, 49, 37, 60, 57, 84 parts.

At ULTRA and EPIC the renderer draws the CC0 Poly Haven mesh \texttt{boulder\_01} (56\,558 triangles) or \texttt{rock\_moss\_set\_01} (2\,754--6\,618 triangles) or \texttt{rock\_moss\_set\_02} (3\,156--4\,886 triangles) in its place; that mesh is imported, not built from primitives, and the primitive parts above stay the model the game logic uses.

Generation rule: 3--4 squashed, rotated spheres, the first full size, the others 45--75\,\% of it, partly buried (seeded).

\noindent\textbf{Tyre tracks.}\label{des:tyre_tracks} Worn dirt tracks of vehicles driving the service ring. One instance, at the origin of the camp. Placement of the first: $T(0.00,\allowbreak\,-0.30,\allowbreak\,0.00)\allowbreak\,R_y(0^\circ)\allowbreak\,S(1)$.

Generation rule: two arcs of the service ring (radius 21.4\,m), cut into steps of at most 6$^\circ$; each step is a pair of thin boxes (ruts) at $r\pm0.6$\,m turned along the tangent (50 ruts).
